app.savingRecognition: Saving recognition metadata and selected crops
app.controlledScope: QuickJS controlled sink · serial execution · no live authority
app.menuDescription: Settings and logs are shared across workspaces. Opening them performs no native operation.
app.workspaceLimit: {limit} workspaces are open. Close one before creating or reopening another; closed workspaces stay saved.
app.workspaceSummary: One operation at a time. Workspaces are saved named sessions, not attached games.
app.closeConfirm: Workspace “{name}” has unsaved profile or target edits. Closing discards them; the workspace, saved profiles, target binding and file logs are kept.
app.connectionFailed: Controller connection failed · last known state retained
app.workspaceLogHelp: Events the host attributed to this workspace, including run events and dismissed notifications.
app.appLogHelp: Application-scoped events carry no workspace; the wider scope shows every retained event with its attributed origin.
app.closedHelp: This session is no longer open. The saved workspace was kept; its events were not transferred to another session.
app.closedEvicted: Its retained detail was evicted from the bounded closed-workspace list.
app.closedLogHelp: Events attributed to this closed session that remain in the shared bounded buffer.
app.firstWorkspace: Create a named workspace or reopen a saved one. Saved open workspaces return at launch with fresh sessions; drafts, results and runs do not.
app.chooseHelp: Choose a workspace from the dropdown above, create a new one, or reopen a saved one.
app.replayDescriptor: Replay needs a recorded corpus descriptor path.
app.replayEnvironment: Replay needs a saved OCR environment.
app.descriptorLimit: The descriptor path exceeds {limit} bytes and cannot be retained by the host.
app.profileBinding: This saved profile belongs to a different package or schema. Reinspect; it cannot be rebound.
app.numericFields: Correct the numeric fields before saving, validating, or starting.
app.unboundWorkspace: This workspace has no inspected package. Inspect a local package directory before package commands.
app.environmentChanged: Saved settings no longer match this environment. Save changes, then Check again.
app.validated: Draft validated by the backend. Start will validate again.
app.earlierValidated: An earlier draft was validated. Current edits still need validation.
app.profileRenamed: Renamed saved profile to “{name}”. Draft values are unchanged.
app.profileDeleted: Saved profile deleted. Its values remain in this unsaved draft; active runs are unchanged.
app.profilesImported: Legacy import · {imported} imported, {unchanged} already present. Source files were kept.
app.profilesImportPartial: Legacy import stopped · {imported} imported, {unchanged} already present. Committed entries stay; retry skips identical ones and refuses conflicts.
app.reinspected: Package reinspected. The profile draft was reset to schema defaults; target setup reloads saved configuration without reusing earlier checks. Start will revalidate its identity.
app.bound: Package inspected and bound to this workspace. Start will revalidate its identity and capture current values.
app.created: Workspace saved. It has no package yet; create or open one for Edit, or inspect a local package directory when you are ready.
app.reopened: Workspace reopened with a fresh session. Saved names and package settings were kept; no draft or run was restored.
app.deletedElsewhere: Saved profile “{name}” was deleted outside this workspace. Its values remain in this unsaved draft.
app.updatedElsewhere: Saved profile “{name}” was updated outside this workspace. This draft keeps its own values: Update profile overwrites the saved ones; to load them instead, pick “Unsaved draft” and then the profile.
app.renamedElsewhere: Saved profile was renamed to “{name}” outside this workspace. Draft values are unchanged.
app.stopRequested: Stop requested. Waiting for independent cleanup and terminal evidence.
app.settingsSaved: Saved · OCR profile {profile}. Nothing was initialized; active operations keep their captured settings.
app.settingsSavedEmpty: Saved · no OCR environment. Active operations keep their captured settings.
app.waitForCommand: Wait for “{command}” to settle before closing this workspace.
app.ownerCannotClose: This workspace owns the active operation. Stop it and wait for the terminal outcome before closing.
app.recoverySaved: Recovered “{name}” · {id}. Its saved values now match the inspected schema; active runs are unchanged.
app.recoveryEarlierSaved: An earlier draft of “{name}” · {id} was saved. Edits made after submission were not saved and remain in the draft.
app.recoveryResetIncomplete: Reset was not saved: the current defaults do not form a valid profile. The saved original is unchanged; complete the default-based draft below and save it.
app.recoveryRequired: Saved profiles need repair before this directory can be bound. It is a recovery candidate only: nothing runs from it and the previous source reference is kept.
app.recoveryBound: Candidate bound to this workspace. Recovered profiles are usable; Start will revalidate its identity and capture current values.
app.recoveryDiscarded: Recovery context discarded. Completed profile writes stay saved; any previous source reference is kept. Inspect again to bind a source.
app.inspectionOutcomes: Package inspected · {saved} saved automatically, {pending} need repair or failed; see Profile recovery below. The profile draft was reset to schema defaults.
app.authoringOpened: Opened for Edit. Ordinary Start and OCR Check are refused in every workspace until you exit Edit; opening did not run package code.
app.authoringCreated: Created a TypeScript starter package and opened it for Edit. Nothing was run or bound to this workspace.
app.authoringResumed: Edit files reloaded from disk. Local file edits and recognition edits not yet synchronized to the host are unavailable after a WebView reload.
app.authoringDuplicated: Duplicated to {path} as {id}. The original package and local configuration are unchanged; Edit now owns the copy.
app.authoringSaved: Saved {path} · revision {revision}. Saving does not validate or bind the package.
app.authoringEarlierSaved: An earlier draft of {path} was saved · revision {revision}. Edits made after Save are still unsaved.
app.authoringSavedRefreshFailed: {path} was saved · revision {revision}, but refreshing the package view failed. Do not repeat the Save; refresh the view.
app.authoringCatalogSaved: Package files updated · revision {revision}. Imports were not rewritten; Validate reports broken ones.
app.authoringCatalogRefreshFailed: The file change was committed · revision {revision}, but refreshing the package view failed. Do not repeat it; refresh the view before further changes.
app.authoringRefreshed: Package view refreshed · revision {revision}. Unsaved drafts were kept.
app.authoringDiskChanged: Package view refreshed. {count} unsaved drafts differ from the latest disk text and are marked: Save replaces the disk text, Discard file changes adopts it.
app.authoringConflict: The package changed on disk since this view was read. Nothing was saved and your draft is kept. Refresh the package view, then save again.
app.authoringValidated: Revision {revision} passed validation. Exit Edit, then Inspect or Reinspect before running it.
app.authoringInvalid: Revision {revision} failed validation · {count} diagnostics. Package code was not run.
app.authoringEarlierValidated: Validation finished for earlier revision {revision}; the package was saved again since. Validate again.
app.authoringDiscarded: Discarded unsaved changes to {path}. Undo restores them.
app.authoringExited: Edit ended. Nothing was bound automatically: Inspect or Reinspect this package before running it.
app.selectionInvalidated: This workspace's inspected selection is no longer current (for example, its package was edited). Inspect or Reinspect the package before running.
app.recoveryInvalidated: This workspace's recovery context is no longer current; any unsaved repair draft was cleared. Saved profiles are unchanged. Inspect the package again before running.
app.authoringRecovered: The interrupted package save was resolved. Inspect the package or open it for Edit again to continue.
app.authoringStopRequested: Authoring Stop requested. Waiting for its child to be cleaned up.
app.recognitionDraftChanged: The recognition draft changed while the command was pending. The newer edits were kept; retry the action.
app.recognitionManifestDirty: Save or discard the manifest draft before Recognition Save. Save all saves file drafts first and preserves failures.
app.recognitionPreviewFailed: The preview window could not receive the current Edit state. Reopen the preview to retry.
app.recognitionSaved: Recognition metadata and selected crops were saved. Package source was not generated or synchronized.
app.recognitionCopied: Snippet copied. Paste deliberately; no package source file was changed.
app.recognitionUnavailable: Recognition metadata is unavailable. Reload the recognition view before continuing.

validation.finiteNumber: Enter a finite number; an empty field is not zero.
validation.negativeZero: Negative zero cannot round-trip through desktop JSON without losing its sign.
validation.safeInteger: Enter an exact integer within the JavaScript safe integer range.
validation.exactNumber: This integer cannot be represented exactly by the numeric editor.
validation.storedText: The saved value is text, not a number; replace it before saving. Nothing is converted for you.
validation.unsupportedProfile: This saved profile is not supported by this desktop build.
validation.runtimePath: Enter the OCR runtime library path.
validation.libraries: Enter 1–64 reviewed native library paths, one per line.
validation.logLimit: GUI log limit must be an integer from 1 to 10000.
validation.visibleCount: Choose one or two visible cards.
validation.success: Success visibility must be on or off.
validation.packagesRoot: Enter an absolute sources folder of at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, without parent traversal or control characters; leave blank for the default.
validation.draftChanged: the environment draft has unsaved edits
validation.descriptorChanged: a different corpus descriptor is selected
validation.workspaceChanged: a different workspace or selection revision is current
